# DeskMint — Every Tool. One Smarter Workspace.

> DeskMint is a fast, privacy-first web workspace offering free online PDF tools, exact-KB PDF & image compressors, Indian university CGPA-to-percentage calculators, everyday utilities, an AI writing studio, and a 130+ language translator.

## Privacy & Architecture
- **100% Browser-Based Core Mint**: All PDF tools, image tools, calculators, date tools, word counters, and QR code generators run locally inside the user's browser. Files never leave the user's device.
- **Privacy-First AI**: AI Studio and Translation Studio process text securely in real time with zero storage.
- **No Forced Accounts**: Users can immediately use all tools without signing up.

## Flagship Mint & High-Intent Pages
### PDF Compression & Editing (Local, Browser-Based)
- Compress PDF (Smart Auto + Custom Target Size KB/MB, zero bloat): /tools/compress-pdf
- Compress PDF to 100KB: /tools/compress-pdf-to-100kb
- Compress PDF to 200KB: /tools/compress-pdf-to-200kb
- Compress PDF to 50KB: /tools/compress-pdf-to-50kb
- Merge PDF, Split PDF, Rotate PDF, Remove PDF Pages, PDF to JPG, Images to PDF, Add Page Numbers, Add Watermark

### Image Compression & Editing (Local, Browser-Based)
- Image Compressor (Quality Slider + Custom Target Size KB/MB + WebP): /tools/image-compressor
- Compress Image to 50KB (Exam & Passport Photos): /tools/compress-image-to-50kb
- Compress Image to 20KB (Signatures): /tools/compress-image-to-20kb
- Image Resizer, Image Converter, Image Cropper

### Indian University CGPA & SGPA Calculators
- CGPA Calculator (with Indian university presets): /tools/cgpa-calculator
- SPPU (Pune University 2019 & 2024 Pattern) CGPA to Percentage: /tools/sppu-cgpa-to-percentage
- Mumbai University CGPA to Percentage: /tools/mumbai-university-cgpa-to-percentage
- DBATU (Maharashtra) CGPA to Percentage: /tools/dbatu-cgpa-to-percentage
- RTMNU (Nagpur University) CGPA to Percentage: /tools/rtmnu-cgpa-to-percentage
- VTU (Karnataka) CGPA to Percentage: /tools/vtu-cgpa-to-percentage
- AKTU (UPTU) CGPA to Percentage: /tools/aktu-cgpa-to-percentage
- Anna University CGPA to Percentage: /tools/anna-university-cgpa-to-percentage
- GTU (Gujarat) CGPA to Percentage: /tools/gtu-cgpa-to-percentage
- Age Calculator (with birthday celebration), Percentage Calculator, Attendance Calculator, Unit Converter

### Global Translator & AI Studio
- 130+ World & Indian Language Translator: /tools/translator
- English to Marathi Translator: /tools/english-to-marathi-translator
- English to Hindi Translator: /tools/english-to-hindi-translator
- Hindi to English Translator: /tools/hindi-to-english-translator
- AI Email Writer, AI Summarizer, AI Grammar Checker, AI Rewriter, AI Notes Generator, AI PDF Summarizer
